description: Five million dollars. One bad decision. An interactive heist thriller where the crew calls the shots.

participation.shareText: Five million dollars. Zero alibis. Join the CRIMEX HOUSE crew, play free games, and help call the next move.

faq.question: Does it cost anything to join or play?
faq.answer: Watching, the crew board, practice games, and the episode vault are free. A free website account is needed only to save Crew Credits from daily missions. Rewards and weekly rankings require creator-confirmed crew membership.

faq.question: How do I vote on the next move?
faq.answer: When an episode is released, watch its Instagram Reel and comment your choice there. Choosing an option on this website prepares your comment; your Instagram comment casts the vote.

faq.question: Can I play without creating an account?
faq.answer: Yes. Room 17, Dead Drop, Signal Intercept, and the released episode vault are open without an account. Daily missions use a free website account to save credits. Existing practice-game scores do not automatically award credits.

faq.question: Is my crew pin public?
faq.answer: Your personal pin, theory draft, and game records are saved on your device. They are not uploaded automatically. Share your theory in the Instagram comments to join the public conversation.

faq.question: Where do I watch the episodes?
faq.answer: Story episodes link to their Instagram Reels. YouTube is a separate home for upcoming full-length episodes.

faq.question: How do I earn Crew Credits?
faq.answer: Join Daily Missions with your Instagram handle and a separate website password. Complete the cipher, case briefing and evidence memory challenge for up to 50 credits a day. Follow @crimex.house and DM your crew code for manual verification before redeeming rewards or appearing in the weekly Top 10.
